description:
## [1.3.21](https://github.com/lopikss/lopikss-patches/compare/v1.3.20...v1.3.21) (2026-10-30)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **xp-hero:** make every hero's unlock-piece cost free ([299986e](https://github.com/lopikss/lopikss-patches/commit/299986eac30994e0c9c170f18c06e58b85bf3592))

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Hero Evolve
patches.description: Experimental: zero hero evolution materials and pieces.

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Hero Level Up
patches.description: Experimental: zero hero level-up resource costs.

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Hero Upgrade (0 Shards)
patches.description: Experimental: shows 0 shards, credits +1 just before the normal 1-shard upgrade, then consumes it. Net cost 0; do not combine with 1-shard fallback.

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Rune Upgrades
patches.description: Experimental: zero both resource costs for all 1,440 rune upgrade levels.

patches.name: XP Hero | Free S-Ticket Rolls
patches.description: Experimental: make S-Ticket rolls cost 0 in XP Hero 26.2.0.

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Shops
patches.description: Choose which shop categories have zero in-game currency prices. Open patch settings for six toggles.

options.description: Zero 300 non-IAP Daily Gem Shop prices.
Zero the 24 in-game material Exchange prices.
Zero 27 additional local non-IAP shop prices.

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Tickets & Return
patches.description: Instant free Return portal uses in the field (no daily-reset wait), plus free ticket refills; paid purchases unchanged.

options.description: Set the configured daily cap for PvP, Boss Raid, Heroes' Tomb and Challenge Tower. Range: 1–5000.
Return can be used immediately away from base, without waiting for the daily reset. The shown count is virtual, not a stored or decremented inventory; the paid offer stays unchanged.
Experimental: increase the game's initial free-return setting from 3. May be limited by online checks.

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Trait Presets
patches.description: Experimental: zero save/load costs for four trait presets (not rerolls).

patches.name: XP Hero | Free Trait Rerolls
patches.description: Experimental: change the ARM64 trait reroll cost calculator to return 0, including for locked traits.

patches.name: XP Hero | Hero Upgrade (1 Shard - Fallback)
patches.description: Confirmed working fallback; costs one shard. Disable when selecting Free Hero Upgrade (0 Shards).

patches.name: XP Hero | Unlock All Heroes (FREE)
patches.description: Experimental: all heroes cost 0 unlock pieces; the native zero-amount consume path keeps its normal notifications. Other unlock conditions may still apply.
